parameters.status: Comparative concept study; placements and engineering inputs are hypotheses, not construction specifications
parameters.coordinate_system: metres; X east, Y north, Z up; structural worker maps global Z to 2D Y

supports.status: Eight hollow support/core envelopes per block, within the inherited 30% gross allowance. Dimensions and modulus are illustrative. Area load lumps structural dead, finishes, services and imposed load; no separate self-weight is added. No factored/code loads, lateral stability, overburden or capacity check.

daylight.status: Uniform sky, black obstructions, no glass/sun/weather. Horizontal court and vertical facade irradiance are normalized by corresponding unobstructed orientations. The 20% band is a comparison marker, not a daylight standard.

utilities.status: Two spatially separated A/B service spines and section-entry boundaries. Graph connectivity only; capacities, autonomy, pump head/friction, electrical protection, heat rejection, sewage and evacuation are not validated. A and B upstream independence is not established.
